name: 螺旋丸

code: function executeSkill(context) { var caster = context.piece; var battle = context.battle; var target = selectTarget({ type: 'piece', range: 1, filter: 'enemy' }); if (!target || target.needsTargetSelection) return target; if (target.currentHp <= 0) return { success: false, message: '目标已出局' }; var dmg = caster.attack; var result = dealDamage(caster, target, dmg, 'physical', battle, context.skill.id); caster.attack += 1; if (!target.statusTags) target.statusTags = []; var tag = target.statusTags.find(function(t) { return t.type === 'flying-raijin-mark' && t.sourceId === caster.instanceId; }); if (tag) { tag.stacks = (tag.stacks || 1) + 1; tag.currentDuration = -1; } else { addStatusEffectById(target.instanceId, { id: 'flying-raijin-mark-' + caster.instanceId + '-' + target.instanceId + '-' + Date.now(), type: 'flying-raijin-mark', name: '飞雷神', visible: true, currentDuration: -1, currentUses: -1, intensity: 1, stacks: 1, sourceId: caster.instanceId }); } return { success: true, message: caster.name + '对' + target.name + '释放螺旋丸，造成' + result.damage + '点伤害，攻击力+1，并附加1层飞雷神标记' }; }
